about_short_description.short_description: Online store for WhatsApp. Take chat orders & payments online better.

product.name: WhatsApp Order Form
product.description: A tool that allows customers to place orders independently through WhatsApp by specifying product choices and scheduling, reducing repetitive inquiries.

product.name: Online Order Management
product.description: A system to track order status, provide order summaries, invoice links, and send order notifications to customers.

product.name: Local Payment Methods
product.description: A payment processing service that accepts QR payments, over 70 local payment methods, credit/debit cards, and cash on delivery.

product.name: WhatsApp Business API
product.description: An API service that automates and manages customer messaging on WhatsApp, including broadcast messaging and shared team inbox.

product.name: Website Builder
product.description: A tool to create websites quickly with product catalogs, Instagram link-in-bio, and custom domain support.

product.name: All-In-One Business Software (WhatsApp-first ERP)
product.description: An ERP software designed for small businesses that integrates CRM, inventory management, wholesale pricing, analytics, and membership rewards, centered around WhatsApp.
